headline: LABEL SEMANTICS AND WHAT A MARKET ENTRY IMPLIES (verified in SpeedAlert_FlashGold_Micro.mq5; PARENT_EA_SOURCE.txt has byte-identical ScoreOrderFlow, AddFlowVote, WinnerSide, DecideAction, MarketEntryAllowedByFlow, ShortComment, ArmEntryHold, ProcessArmedEntryHold, BuildDirectionState, PlaceAction): ScoreOrderFlow 2463-2493 + AddFlowVote 2556-2570: each of FORCE/NEAR/BOOK with |v| >= 5.0 (line 251) is a buy/sell vote worth +1.0 score; 2 of 3 agreeing gives flowDir +-1, else 0; OK<0.5 or age>4000 ms gives no votes at all. :FA/:FD compare flowDir with the score WINNER (BuildDirectionState 2345-2346, ShortComment 3140-3141), not with the trade side (they coincide only for market and stop-with-burst entries; limit fades are excluded here). Enumerating the rules (verify_flow_label_algebra.py, 243 states per side) for MARKET entries: every market entry has >= 1 vote with the trade; :FD <=> exactly 1 vote with + 2 against AND M1 body + micro-break with the trade; no label <=> buys only (SELL with neutral flow is downgraded to a stop, DowngradeNeutralSellMarketToStop line 254), exactly 1 vote with, body + micro with the trade; :FA <=> >= 2 votes with (any price state); a stale feed can never give a market entry; with zero votes even body+micro+speed+spread scores 4.5 < WeakFlowMarketMinScore 5.0 and routes to a stop, so the feed is what unlocks the market route (74.0% of the real trades). The data agree: SM+none 0 of 965, BM+none 132 of 946 (14.0%), M1 body >= 21 pts held in 80 of 80 'none' entries (Wilson lower bound 95.4%).

TIMING (changes how any proxy must be built): the account runs InpUseEntryHold=true, InpEntryHoldMs=1100 (saved-chart inputs; FlashGold_NativeReference_DISABLED.set lines 131-133; source default false/1000 at lines 276-277). OnTick builds the DirectionState at line 1198 and arms the hold at 1241; ArmEntryHold stores that state (1781); ProcessArmedEntryHold re-reads it (1807) and calls PlaceAction(action, t, state) (1874) whose comment comes from ShortComment(action, s) (2970). So the :FA/:FD/none label is the feed verdict at HOLD ARMING, >= 1.1 s (first tick after) + ~150 ms before the fill, not 150 ms before it. The trade list stamps whole seconds (floor), so the decision sits at about T-0.9 s +-0.5 s (T = stamped UTC second; server = UTC+3 re-verified: median |entry - Dukascopy mid| 0.082 USD at +3 h against 10.4 / 11.8 at +2 / +4 h); the brief's t0 = T-150 ms is on average ~0.75 s too late. Three anchors were evaluated (lit T-150, rel T+350, arm T-900) plus a lag scan from T-3 s to T+1 s; no conclusion depends on the choice. Mean mid move with the trade: +15.4 (T-3.40..T-2.15 s), +39.3 [36.5, 42.3] (T-2.15..T-0.90), +23.8 (T-0.90..T+0.35), then +1.0 [-0.7, +2.9] in the 1.25 s after the order: the entry fires after the burst.

BASE RATES (Wilson 95%): all 2,584 trades FA 62.3% [60.4, 64.1] / FD 15.8% [14.5, 17.3] / none 21.9% [20.4, 23.5]; market entries (all scenario FOLM, n=1,911, BM 946 + SM 965) 79.9% [78.0, 81.6] / 13.2% [11.7, 14.8] / 6.9% [5.9, 8.1]; BM 74.1 / 11.9 / 14.0, SM 85.6 / 14.4 / 0.0; non-FOLM (n=673) 12.2 / 23.3 / 64.5 (FLXQ n=394: 3.8 / 24.4 / 71.8; EXHL n=236: 28.0 / 18.2 / 53.8, labels there are relative to the winner). The label is the conditional output of route + score + gates, not a free draw. 100% [99.7, 100] of covered market entries go with the last 10 s mid move (1,253 of 1,253 at the lit anchor; 1,244 of 1,250 at arm), and agrees is 86.8% [84.7, 88.6] of agrees+disagrees (n=1,173), so 'agrees = momentum' cannot be tested: there is no contrast group.

DETERMINISTIC PROXY: NOT FEASIBLE. Sample 1,260 covered market entries (1,025 FA / 155 FD / 80 none, 144 UTC-hour clusters, 19 days), 348 candidates (14 signed feature families + 2 combinations x 7 windows 0.5-30 s x 3 anchors, plus EA gates). Best unselected AUC agrees-vs-disagrees 0.406 [0.359, 0.454] (3 s mid move/spread, INVERSE sign; family-wise label-permutation p = 0.043); best walk-forward select-then-test AUC 0.537 [0.479, 0.597] (n_test 787 = 689/98; best single family mid change 0.570 [0.507, 0.628]); best model of any kind (ridge logistic, 12 price/quote/size features, arm anchor) 0.586 [0.519, 0.648], best of 8 variants. None-vs-not-none (BM only, 621 rows, 80 none): best |x| AUC 0.605 [0.541, 0.666], walk-forward 0.535 [0.447, 0.614]. Best 3-class threshold rule = 'always agrees' in every fold: 82.0% = baseline, gain 0.000. A usable replacement needs AUC >~ 0.9. Pipeline power check: planted AUC 0.64 is recovered as 0.63, 0.75 as 0.74, null as 0.51, so a proxy with AUC >= ~0.6 would have been found.

STOCHASTIC LABEL MODEL CONDITIONAL ON QUOTE FEATURES: no gain over the base rate. Walk-forward log-loss improvement over the base-rate model is -4.2% .. +1.4% for all 16 ridge-logistic variants (anchors lit/arm, with/without sizes, lambda 3/30; best +1.4% [-0.9, +3.7]); UTC hour-of-day table +0.2 / +0.7% (agrees) and -5.6 / -2.3% (none); label of the previous real trade within 10 min +1.3% [-0.7, +3.4]. Labels do cluster in time (P(next market trade has the same label) 0.685 vs 0.648-0.672 under random order, p=0.001, n=1,910; none->none 15.2% vs 6.9% base; hour-of-day heterogeneity p=0.011; calendar day p=0.27), so a slow feed/regime component exists, but quotes do not reveal it. The only meaningful conditioning is structural (route, side, body/micro gate, vote counts), which belongs inside the engine's own code.

THE ONLY STRUCTURED ASSOCIATION IS SELECTION, NOT FLOW INFORMATION: 2-3 s momentum with the trade is LOWER when the feed agrees (AUC 0.41; 0.43 even inside body>=21), because weak-flow entries (:FD, none) must pass body AND micro-break while :FA need not. Body >= 21 pts at the arming second: none 100% (80/80), FD 91.6%, FA 87.7%; micro-break at some tick of the arming second: none 96.2%, FD 92.9%, FA 79.2%. Inside the subset where both gates hold (n=853, 131 FD) the AUC is 0.47 [0.42, 0.53] (tick-rule 0.49-0.51, 10 s move 0.495). The dip is confined to windows ending T-1.75 s .. T+0.25 s (0.40 at T-0.75 s) and is 0.50 for windows ending before T-2 s or after T+0.75 s. Consequence: a model fitted on labelled trades inherits the gate; the unconditional feed-price relation is not identifiable from these labels.

QUOTE SIZES CARRY NOTHING USABLE: Dukascopy top-of-book sizes are quantised, 76.7-77.7% (raw Sep-Nov 2026) and 85.3% (data/hf Mar 2026) of ticks sit at the minimum 0.00012, and the size imbalance is exactly 0 on 67.5% (raw) / 76.9% (hf) of ticks (check_hf_sizes.py); corr(ask size, bid size) differs (0.05 raw vs 0.72 hf). Microprice minus mid in spread units is algebraically (bidsize-asksize)/(2(bidsize+asksize)) (max difference 1e-12 over all rows), so feature (5) duplicates feature (4); size-only walk-forward AUC 0.504 [0.441, 0.567]; the only right-signed families are the size-imbalance changes (dsi 0.547 [0.507, 0.596], dsh 0.534 [0.458, 0.612]), not significant after ~350 candidates. Sizes are not in MqlTick, so they could not be used in the tester anyway.

THE LABEL DOES NOT PREDICT RESULTS OR PRICE DIRECTION: realised points per 0.01 lot FA -5.7 [-12.0, +0.8] (n=1,025), FD +3.8 [-10.8, +19.5] (n=155), none -13.3 [-37.2, +11.1] (n=80), FA minus FD -9.6 [-26.3, +7.3]; all 1,911 market trades -8.8 / +0.4 / -12.7. The realised relation flips with side: FA minus FD +16.3 [-4.2, +35.8] on buys (701/113) and -30.1 [-50.0, -12.1] on sells (826/139), interaction +46.3 [19.1, 74.0] (gold fell 7.2%, 4,430.8 -> 4,113.5), but the label-independent 10 s forward mid move shows no flip (buys -2.5 [-20.7, +15.3], sells -11.4 [-30.3, +6.3], interaction +8.9 [-18.2, +35.7]), so it is an exit-rule/drift effect (:FD gets defensive exits, lines 10900-10953 and 11232 (lines 11086, 11326 and 11441 only copy the label into logs); stop-loss share 51.5 / 49.0 / 57.5%). The feed's absolute buy/sell verdict does not predict the next move: raw mid change BUY minus SELL = +1.7 [-5.1, +8.2] (5 s), -1.0 [-9.2, +7.5] (10 s), -5.0 [-17.8, +8.8] (30 s), n~1,170. Overall drift after the fill is ~0: +1.8 / +1.6 / +1.4 pts at 5 / 10 / 30 s (SD 56 / 76 / 124, n~1,250), against ~37 pts round-trip cost.

THE RAW NUMBERS ALREADY EXIST IN THE LIVE LOGS (not in the repository): LogDecision writes flow_fresh, flow_dir, force_imb, near_imb, book_imb (lines 13147-13151; header in WriteHeader ~12789-12880) for PLACED, SKIP, SHADOW and FAILED events into SpeedAlertRouter_XAUUSD_scenario_v48_3.csv (input CsvLogFileV483Cost line 158; time to the second), and SarOrderFlowDecisionLog (5046-5110, SAR_OrderFlowDecision_v2.csv, line 495) logs time_msc, the external program's master VWAP, contributor count (LIVE_FEEDS) and broker mid. Those rows, SKIPs included, are the unselected numeric sample needed to fit the vote distribution, update cadence and correlation and to re-test price->flow predictability without the selection problem. The VWAP/LIVE_FEEDS names (lines 2515-2553, telemetry only, no decision uses them) suggest a multi-venue aggregator, i.e. information that is not in broker quotes (inference, unverified).
sample: 2,584 real trades (7 Sep - 8 Oct 2026, XAUUSD-ECN, 0.01 lot) from results/real/real_trades_sar.csv: 946 BM + 965 SM market (1,911 = 74.0%), 201 BS + 236 SS stop, 125 BL + 111 SL limit. Broker server time = UTC+3 re-verified (median |entry - Dukascopy mid| 0.082 USD at +3 h; 10.4 / 11.8 at +2 / +4 h). Raw ticks: 835 hourly .bi5 files (45 zero-length) over 52 UTC days: hours chosen by trade count 8 Sep-2 Oct plus continuous 6 Oct-13 Nov. Analysed market sample (entry hour or previous hour for entries in the first 60 s present, >= 1 tick within 3 s of the stamped second): 1,260 of 1,911 (66%): 1,025 agrees / 155 disagrees / 80 none (BM 621 = 472/69/80, SM 639 = 553/86/0), 144 UTC-hour bootstrap clusters on 19 UTC days; label shares 81.3 / 12.3 / 6.3% against 79.9 / 13.2 / 6.9% for all 1,911. Stop entries with ticks (exploratory only): 225 (12 / 78 / 135). Limit entries excluded: their label refers to the score winner, usually the burst side or none, opposite to the fade trade, so it cannot be sign-aligned. Walk-forward folds: 6 chronological blocks of 210 rows, train on blocks < k, test on k = 3..6 (840 rows: 689 FA, 98 FD, 53 none; BM-only none test set 417 rows = 53 none / 364 other). Bootstrap = 1,000 cluster resamples by UTC hour. Null SE of an AUC: 0.025 (agrees vs disagrees) and 0.035 (none vs not, BM only), so |AUC - 0.5| below ~0.05-0.07 is undetectable here.

proxies.name: (1) mid-price change: mv (points) and mvs (divided by mean Dukascopy spread)
proxies.definition: mid(t0) - mid(t0-W) in points, x side; W = 0.5, 1, 2, 3, 5, 10, 30 s; anchors lit T-150 ms, rel T+350, arm T-900
proxies.auc_agree_vs_disagree: unselected best at the literal anchor: mvs 3 s 0.406 [0.359, 0.454], mv 3 s 0.417 [0.372, 0.464]; range over 21 anchor/window cells 0.406-0.550; walk-forward select-then-test (within family) mv 0.568 [0.505, 0.629], mvs 0.570 [0.507, 0.628]; sign is INVERSE (stronger recent move with the trade = less likely agrees)
proxies.notes: MT5-computable (bid/ask/time_msc). The inverse association is the weak-flow gate (body+micro needed for FD/none): inside the both-gates subset AUC = 0.473 [0.416, 0.527] (n=853). Lag scan mvs@2 s: 0.40 for windows ending T-0.75 .. T+0 ms, 0.50 outside T-2 s .. T+0.75 s.

proxies.name: (2) tick-rule imbalance: ti (#mid up-ticks minus #down-ticks) and tin (normalised)
proxies.definition: consecutive-tick mid changes inside (t0-W, t0], starting from the quote prevailing at the window start; ti = up - down, tin = (up-down)/(up+down), x side
proxies.notes: MT5-computable. Inside the both-gates subset tin@2 s = 0.513 [0.459, 0.566] (lit) / 0.487 (arm): nothing left.

proxies.name: (3) quote-update imbalance by side: qa (ask), qb (bid), qd (direction), ql (ask-led minus bid-led)
proxies.definition: qa = #ask up - #ask down, qb = #bid up - #bid down; qd = (qa+qb)/(#ask changes + #bid changes); ql = (qa-qb)/(#ask changes + #bid changes); all x side
proxies.notes: MT5-computable (which side changed is also in MqlTick.flags). Computed on Dukascopy updates, which differ from the broker's own update stream.

proxies.name: (4) quote-size imbalance: sim (window mean) and sil (last tick) of (bidsize-asksize)/(bidsize+asksize)
proxies.definition: per tick (bv-av)/(bv+av), x side; mean over the window and value of the last tick
proxies.notes: NOT available in the MT5 tester (no sizes in MqlTick). Sizes are quantised: 77% of ticks at the minimum 0.00012, imbalance exactly 0 on 67.5% of raw ticks (76.9% in data/hf).

proxies.name: (5) microprice minus mid: mpp (points) and mps (spread units)
proxies.definition: microprice = (bid*asksize + ask*bidsize)/(bidsize+asksize); mpp = (micro-mid) in points, mps = (micro-mid)/spread, x side
proxies.auc_agree_vs_disagree: mps = sil/2 exactly (max difference 1e-12), so identical to sil: lit 10 s 0.517 [0.477, 0.556]; mpp lit 10 s 0.517 [0.477, 0.556]; walk-forward mpp 0.478 [0.438, 0.514], mps 0.497 [0.459, 0.533]
proxies.notes: Algebraically redundant with (4) last; needs sizes.

proxies.name: (6) change of the size imbalance: dsi (last tick minus window start) and dsh (2nd-half mean minus 1st-half mean)
proxies.definition: differences of the per-tick size imbalance, x side
proxies.notes: The only right-signed family (higher with the trade = more likely agrees), AUC ~0.55, not significant after ~350 candidates; needs sizes, so unusable in the tester.

proxies.name: (7) unit-weight combinations: cpx = z(mvs)+z(tin)+z(qd); call = cpx + z(sim) + z(dsi)
proxies.definition: z-scores from the feature's own distribution (no label), summed with unit weights, per anchor and window
proxies.notes: cpx is MT5-computable, call is not. Combining does not beat the best single feature.

proxies.name: (7b) ridge-logistic combination, the 'stochastic label model' (9 price/quote features, +3 size features)
proxies.definition: features: mvs 2 s and 10 s, tin 2 s, qd 2 s, tick rate 2 s, Dukascopy spread 2 s, body, micro-break margin, 10 s move (+ sim 2 s, dsi 5 s, mpp 2 s); lambda 3 and 30; walk-forward, anchors lit and arm; separate models for P(agrees | not none) and P(none | BM)
proxies.auc_agree_vs_disagree: out-of-sample AUC 0.528 [0.467, 0.584] (lit, price/quote, lambda 3) ... 0.586 [0.519, 0.648] (arm, with sizes, lambda 3; best of 8) and 0.583 [0.512, 0.649] (lambda 30); log-loss gain over base rate -1.6% [-4.7, +1.3] ... +1.4% [-0.9, +3.7]
proxies.notes: The multi-feature AUC of 0.58 buys at most ~1% log-loss on a 87/13 split: not useful as a generator.

proxies.name: (8) EA price gates at the decision tick: M1 body, micro-break margin, 10 s move, last spread
proxies.definition: body = (mid - bid at the minute start) x side; micro = margin over the previous 10 s extreme (current tick excluded) x side; 10 s mid move x side; Dukascopy spread of the last tick
proxies.auc_neutral_vs_not: share with body >= 21 pts: none 100% (80/80) vs disagrees 91.6% vs agrees 87.7% (arm grid); micro-break at any tick of the arming second: 96.2% / 92.9% / 79.2%
proxies.three_class_accuracy: 0.820 [0.787, 0.852] = always-agrees, gain 0.000 (sign-of-10 s-move baseline is identical)
proxies.notes: These are the selection fingerprints of the weak-flow gate, not flow information. Micro-break at a fixed 1 s-resolution anchor is only 22-34% for 'none' (should be 100%): timing noise; the 1 s grid fixes it.

proxies.name: (9) activity and regime features: tick count/rate, mean Dukascopy spread, mid range
proxies.definition: nt, rate, spr, rng over each window (unsigned)
proxies.auc_agree_vs_disagree: spread@2 s 0.57 [0.52, 0.62] at every lag from T-3 s to T+1 s (flat in time, i.e. a regime/time-of-day proxy: wider Dukascopy spread = more agrees)
proxies.auc_neutral_vs_not: BM only: range 1 s arm 0.601 [0.534, 0.660] (larger range when none), tick count/rate lit 2 s 0.534 [0.473, 0.595]; walk-forward 0.503-0.535
proxies.notes: Dukascopy spread median 64 pts against 12-15 at the broker: scale is not transferable.

proxies.name: (10) time-of-day table and previous-label history (regime baselines, not quote features)
proxies.definition: UTC hour table shrunk to the training base rate (m = 10, 30); one-hot label of the previous real trade within 10 min
proxies.notes: Shows that whatever weak predictability exists (AUC ~0.56-0.59) is as large for regime/history as for quote features.

proxies.name: (11) stop-order entries BS/SS (exploratory; decision 1.1 s hold + up to 5 s pending life before the fill)
proxies.definition: same features at 2 s windows ending 0.5 .. 6 s before the stamped second; disagrees vs none (agrees too rare: 12)
proxies.auc_agree_vs_disagree: n=225 (12 agrees / 78 disagrees / 135 none): disagrees-vs-none AUC of mvs, tin, qd, rate, spread over 6 lags 0.46-0.59, best mvs 3.5 s before 0.591 [0.522, 0.670] (1 of 30 tests)
proxies.notes: Nothing beyond chance; decision time too blurred to test properly.

baselines: Test blocks 3-6 (n=840 market entries: 689 FA / 98 FD / 53 none), 3-class accuracy with cluster-bootstrap 95% CI: always 'agrees' 82.0% [78.7, 85.2]; sign of the 10 s price move (agrees if the trade side matches the move; the EA only trades with the burst, so this is always-agrees) 82.0% [78.7, 85.2]; coin weighted by the training base rate 68.1% [65.8, 70.3] (expected value); best single-feature two-threshold rule fitted on earlier blocks (336 signed candidates, either orientation, degenerate always-agrees included; also run separately inside each of the 16 families) 82.0% [78.7, 85.2], gain over always-agrees 0.000 [0.000, 0.000], recall agrees 1.00 / disagrees 0.00 / none 0.00 in every fold. Accuracy cannot beat the base rate when the minority classes are 12% and 6%, which is why AUC and log-loss are the primary metrics: the rule fitter was checked on synthetic labels, where it beats always-agrees under a strong planted signal (85.7% vs 56.7%) and equals it under none. AUC baselines: always-agrees = 0.5; the 10 s move itself 0.456 [0.411, 0.502] (lit gate) for agrees-vs-disagrees. Base-rate model log-loss is the reference for all stochastic-model gains.
conclusion: (a) Deterministic proxy: NOT feasible. No feature, window, anchor or combination reproduces the verdict (best out-of-sample AUC 0.54-0.59 against ~0.9 needed; best 3-class rule = always agrees). (b) Stochastic label model conditional on quote features: not feasible in any useful sense: every ridge-logistic, hour-of-day and label-history model leaves log-loss within -4.2% .. +1.4% of the base rate with CIs including 0. What IS feasible and needed is a stochastic model of the three imbalance numbers themselves, with the label emerging from the EA's own rules, because the rules fix which labels a market entry can carry (FD only as 1 with / 2 against votes with body+micro; none only on buys with 1 vote; FA with >= 2 votes; no market entry without a live feed). (c) The feed behaves as unpredictable from broker/Dukascopy quotes at the resolution of these data (1 s stamps, selected sample, 155 minority labels): the single reproducible association (2-3 s momentum lower when the feed agrees, AUC 0.41) is a selection artefact of the weak-flow gate and vanishes inside the gate-satisfying subset (0.47 [0.42, 0.53]); the feed's absolute buy/sell verdict does not predict the next 5-30 s mid move; the label does not predict a better outcome (agrees minus disagrees -9.6 [-26.3, +7.3] realised points, realised sign flips between buys and sells but the label-independent forward move does not). Only the unselected numeric logs (force/near/book at every decision, SKIPs included) could prove or disprove predictability in the population. Practical consequence for the brief: do not ask for a price-derived proxy; ask for an exogenous, seeded vote generator, calibrate it to the observed route/label tables, evaluate every direction-logic candidate over many seeds and over bounding flow regimes, and request the live logs.
recommended_design: REPLAY (python/numba engine). 1) Model the numbers, not the label: give the engine's ScoreOrderFlow a generator that returns (flowFresh, forceImb, nearImb, bookImb) and let the already-ported scoring, WinnerSide, DecideAction, MarketEntryAllowedByFlow, entry hold (state frozen at arming, as in the EA) and the :FD exit logic run unchanged; this reproduces the structural facts (FD only with body+micro and 1 with / 2 against, none buys only, FA with >= 2 votes, no market route without a feed) and the selection effects automatically. 2) Generator: per decision bucket of Delta ms (default 1000, real cadence unknown) each component is, relative to the burst direction, 'with' / 'against' / 'neutral' with probabilities (a, b, c) at the |v| >= 5.0 resolution (magnitudes only need to sit above or below 5.0, e.g. +-8 and +-1); components independent to start with; an optional 2-state slow regime (dwell ~5-10 min) modulating a and c to reproduce label persistence; a stale-bucket probability. 3) Calibrate once by simulated method of moments on the 7 Sep-8 Oct window, then freeze: targets = market share of trades 74.0% (1,911/2,584), label mix by action (BM 74.1/11.9/14.0, SM 85.6/14.4/0.0), by scenario (FLXQ 3.8/24.4/71.8, EXHL 28.0/18.2/53.8 relative to the winner), ~117 trades/day, P(next label same) ~0.685. Toy identification with independent components from the two label ratios alone (FA:FD ~6:1 on both sides, none:FD ~1.18:1 on BM) gives P(with) 0.44-0.62, P(against) 0.38-0.26, P(neutral) 0.18-0.12 for a body+micro share of 30-90% among accepted bursts (the SM FA share 85.6% is then predicted as 85.7%, a free consistency check of the downgrade rule): seed values for the search, not estimates. Hold out the SM mix and the FLXQ/EXHL mixes as validation. 4) Never optimise on one flow draw: score every candidate over >= 20 seeds, report mean and SD, and require the gain under flow off (UseOrderFlow=false), always-agree, always-neutral and the calibrated random feed. 5) Direction accuracy metric independent of fills and feed: forward mid move with the decision side at +5/+10/+30 s from the arming tick over ALL decisions the engine makes (taken or not, tens of thousands, net of spread), because real entries show only +1.8/+1.6/+1.4 pts mean with SD 56/76/124 (n~1,250), i.e. an edge below ~5 pts is invisible on real trades alone. 6) Optional oracle mode: force the real label at the real arming time for the 1,260 covered entries to validate route/gate logic (not for optimisation). 7) Efficiency: the price layer (speed, body, micro, spread, follow21/37, FlashGold gate) does not depend on the feed, so compute it once per tick pass and re-run only the flow-dependent layer (score, route, hold, exits) per seed; skip ticks without an active alert. 8) Confirm the engine implements the label-dependent exits (:FD at lines 10900-10953 and 11232 (lines 11086, 11326 and 11441 only copy the label into logs)) or simulated FD entries will behave like FA. MQL5 TWIN. Tester fields: time_msc, bid, ask (+ flags TICK_FLAG_BID/ASK); last/volume are usually 0 for an XAUUSD CFD (verify by printing a few tester ticks); quote sizes do not exist, and no size feature mattered. Because no quote feature predicts the label, the twin needs no feature: add a tester-only FlowSim block replacing the GlobalVariable reads in ScoreOrderFlow (2463-2493): forceImb/nearImb/bookImb synthesised from a counter-based hash h(seed, floor(time_msc/Delta), component) (reproducible, independent of how many ticks the tester delivers), sign relative to speedDir by (a, b, c), magnitude +-8 or +-1, flowFresh true except stale buckets, and bypass the GetTickCount64 age test (wall clock is not tester time). Inputs: FlowSimMode (0 off, 1 random, 2 always agree, 3 always neutral), FlowSimSeed, FlowSimPWith, FlowSimPAgainst, FlowSimBucketMs, FlowSimPStale; run each parameter set under 10-20 FlowSimSeed values and aggregate by parameter set; use real-tick mode with an execution delay >= 150 ms; require the twin and the Python engine to give the same route/label table for the same (a, b, c) before trusting any optimisation. DATA TO REQUEST: SpeedAlertRouter_XAUUSD_scenario_v48_3.csv and SAR_OrderFlowDecision_v2.csv from the live terminal's MQL5/Files; with them replace the parametric generator by block-bootstrapping real (force, near, book) triples conditional on route, fit cadence, correlation and the |v| distribution, and re-test price->flow predictability on the unselected rows.
caveats: Conditional sample: labels exist only for trades that passed score, route, entry hold and all gates, and the flow votes themselves feed the score and the route; FD and none additionally require body AND micro-break (enumerated and visible in the data). Within-sample associations are partly structural and the unconditional feed-price relation cannot be measured from these labels.

Timing: stamps are floor seconds (+-0.5 s) and the label is frozen at hold arming (>= 1.1 s + first tick + ~150 ms before the fill); anchors lit/rel/arm are estimates, Dukascopy tick times differ from the broker's by an unknown amount, and for stop orders the decision is further away (hold + up to 5 s pending life).

Different feeds: Dukascopy (median spread 64 pts, ~4.3 ticks/s in the 10 s before entries) is not the broker stream the EA and the external program saw (spread 12-15 pts per REPORT.md); quote-update features measured on the broker's own ticks in the tester may behave differently. Body and micro-break proxies are only approximate (micro-break is exact only at the decision tick).

Coverage and power: only 1,260 of 1,911 market entries (66%) have ticks, hours chosen by trade count, 144 hour-clusters, 19 days, 155 disagrees, 80 none (BM only). Null SE of an AUC is 0.025 / 0.035; 'no proxy' means none above ~0.6, not exactly 0.5 (planted AUC 0.54-0.59 is not reliably recovered).

Multiplicity and CI scope: 348 strongly correlated candidates (66 outside 0.5 +- 1.96 SE, family-wise permutation p = 0.043 with rows treated as independent); nested-metric CIs hold the selection fixed (slightly narrow); clusters are UTC hours; 'best of 8 variants' ridge AUC 0.586 is selected on label AUC.

Quote sizes are quantised and absent from MqlTick; data/hf behaves similarly (check_hf_sizes.py) but with a different ask/bid size correlation (0.72 vs 0.05), so the two copies are not processed identically.

Outcome analyses: realised points include slippage and label-dependent exits (:FD defensive exits) and a market that fell 7.2% over the window; the buy/sell sign flip of FA minus FD (+16.3 vs -30.1 pts) is not reproduced by the label-independent forward move and has multiplicity (several splits); forward moves are measured from the stamped second + 0.5 s on Dukascopy mid.

Unknowns I could not determine: the numeric scale, update cadence and venues of FORCE/NEAR/BOOK (the 5.0 threshold's position in their distribution), whether MT5 tester ticks carry last/volume for this broker, the exact decision time of each trade, whether the live account used the chart inputs unchanged for the whole window (assumed), and the unconditional price->flow relation.

Label persistence is real but weak (P(next label same) 0.685 vs 0.648-0.672, p=0.001; hour-of-day p=0.011; day p=0.27) and its out-of-sample predictive value is AUC ~0.56; the vote-generator calibration values quoted above assume independent components and an assumed body+micro share, so they are seeds, not results.

Repository note: REPORT.md, REPORT.template.md and tools/make_report.py show uncommitted edits made at 16:08 UTC by another actor, not by this probe (this work only read the repo; REPORT.md now also says the label does not tell the result reliably, with the same buy/sell sign flip). All outputs of this probe are under the flow-proxy-probe folder.
